column7: Sibling of #4520 in the PAT and machine-token network allowlists: EncodePATCIDRs appended /32 to the input text of a bare ::ffff:a.b.c.d, storing the IPv6 network ::/32, so the token was refused from the intended host and accepted from ::1 and every ::/32 address. rules.ParseAllowlistCIDR (encoder and IPInCIDRs) reads a mapped entry with prefix <= 32 as the IPv4 network, which also narrows rows already stored in the old shape; mapped prefixes 33-95 are refused. Found by SECURITY-WAVE1-REVIEW
